title.en: Schools close as more than half of France under red heat alerts
title.zh: 法国一半以上地区处于红色高温警报，学校停课

summary.en: More than half of France is under red heat alerts, leading to school closures. The health minister has warned that many citizens will suffer as temperatures are expected to peak on Monday.
summary.zh: 法国一半以上地区处于红色高温警报之下，导致学校停课。卫生部长警告称，随着气温预计在周一达到峰值，许多公民将“遭受痛苦”。

body.en:
More than half of France's regions are under a red heat alert, as the country braces for sweltering temperatures in an intensifying heatwave.

Highs of more than 40C (104F) are expected across parts of western France on Monday, with temperatures expected to hit 42C in Bordeaux, forecaster Météo-France said.

Some 845 schools have been shut, while a further 1,800 are allowing pupils to finish classes early, the education ministry said. But more than a million high school students are due to take their oral final exams for the baccalaureate.

The French government has warned people not to try to cool off in unsupervised areas such as lakes and rivers, after 13 drowning deaths at the weekend.

A red heat alert is the highest of four warnings issued by Météo-France, and advises people to exercise extreme caution in conditions that are potentially life-threatening.

Dozens of other regions in France are under an orange alert - the second-highest warning - with an estimated 63 million people in total affected across the country.

The national railway operator SNCF urged "vulnerable" people to avoid or postpone train travel this week, while in Paris, several train lines reduced their services on Monday due to the heat.

Belgium's train operator also announced some peak hour trains would be cancelled for Monday and Tuesday. Temperatures in Belgium are expected to reach record levels in the coming week, the IRM meteorological institute said.

Madrid is forecast to hit 39C on Monday and in Italy, temperatures are predicted to reach 37C in Rome.

Red warnings are also in force across other parts of western and central Europe - taking effect in Germany and Switzerland on Monday and in Luxembourg on Tuesday.

The rising temperatures are being driven by hot air moving north from the Sahara desert, which is in turn trapping hot air over western and central Europe with forecasters suggesting the conditions could result in one of the longest heatwaves in recent years.

Météo-France said of the 51 heatwaves recorded in France since 1947, 34 have taken place since 2000 and 26 since 2011.

Spain's state weather service Aemet warned of "extremely high" temperatures for the season until Wednesday "between five and 10 degrees above what is typical".

A red alert has been issued for the Basque country, with highs in San Sebastian forecast to rise to 40C, almost double its average for this time of year.

It comes as the UK's Met Office issued a rare red heat warning on Wednesday and Thursday for parts of England and Wales, with forecasts suggesting temperatures could reach 38C (100F) in some areas this week.

reflection.en: As France faces extreme heat, the health minister's warning of widespread suffering reminds us of the hardships life can bring. Yet, Yahweh's word encourages us that suffering, when endured with perseverance, can build character and ultimately lead to hope. Even in challenging times, we can find strength and a deeper sense of purpose.
reflection.zh: 当法国面临极端高温时，卫生部长关于大范围痛苦的警告提醒我们生活中可能出现的艰难。然而，雅伟的话语鼓励我们，苦难若能以忍耐承受，便能塑造品格，最终带来盼望。即使在充满挑战的时刻，我们也能找到力量和更深刻的生命意义。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: Former Kenyan justice minister blocked from entering Uganda, lawyers' body says
title.zh: 律师机构称前肯尼亚司法部长被禁止进入乌干达

summary.en: Martha Karua is a lawyer representing detained Ugandan opposition leader Kizza Besigye who is on trial for treason.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Leading Kenyan lawyer and former Justice Minister Martha Karua has been blocked from entering Uganda and ordered to return home, according to the Uganda Law Society.

Karua had just arrived at the Entebbe airport to join a team defending her Ugandan lawyer colleague Erias Lukwago, with whom they have been representing detained opposition leader Kizza Besigye, who is on trial for treason.

Lukwago was himself charged with a treason-related offence last week , and his bail hearing had been due on Monday.

A statement from Karua's office said she had been detained at the airport, adding that she was expected to return to the Kenyan capital, Nairobi, on Monday but "remains incommunicado".

"Her senior team reports that she is unreachable, with her mobile phones switched off and they continue to await direct communication regarding her status and expected return," it said.

Ugandan authorities did not give a reason for blocking Karua, although Kenya's Law Society President Charles Kanjama, who had travelled with her, was allowed in.

Kanjama said it was "of particular concern" that Karua had been blocked, despite her travelling "for the same matter and in the same professional capacity" as himself.

"It is difficult to understand why one member of a defence team should be admitted while another is turned away," he said in a post on X, while calling on Ugandan authorities to explain their actions.

Uganda's immigration authorities have not responded to the BBC's request for comment.

Lukwago appeared in court last Wednesday looking weak days after he had been arrested at his home.

He denied charges of failing to report treason relating to Besigye's case and was remanded in prison.

Besigye has been jailed on treason charges since being abducted in Kenya and forcibly returned to Uganda in late 2024. His abduction, alongside that of his aide Obeid Lutale, sparked intense regional debate over legal jurisdiction and human rights.

The Law Society of Kenya on Monday expressed support for "members of the legal profession across East Africa who continue to uphold the cause of justice under often difficult circumstances".

It called on the relevant authorities to provide clarity on the circumstances that Karua had been denied entry to Uganda.

Karua faced several hurdles before she was eventually cleared to represent Besigye - including her initial application to practise as a lawyer in Uganda being rejected.

She was also deported from Tanzania last year to prevent her from attending the court case of opposition leader Tundu Lissu, who also faces treason charges.
body.zh: 据乌干达律师协会称，肯尼亚著名律师、前司法部长玛莎·卡鲁亚已被禁止进入乌干达，并被勒令返回家园。 卡鲁亚刚刚抵达恩德培机场，加入为她的乌干达律师同事埃里亚斯·卢瓦戈辩护的团队，他们一直与埃里亚斯·卢瓦戈一起代表被拘留的反对派领导人基扎·贝西吉耶，后者因叛国罪而受审。 卢克瓦戈本人上周被指控犯有叛国罪，他的保释听证会将于周一举行。 卡鲁亚办公室的一份声明称，她已在机场被拘留，并补充说，预计她将于周一返回肯尼亚首都内罗毕，但“仍与外界隔绝”。 声明称：“她的高级团队报告称，无法联系到她，她的手机已关闭，他们仍在等待有关她的状况和预期回归的直接沟通。” 乌干达当局没有给出阻止卡鲁阿的理由，不过与她同行的肯尼亚律师协会主席查尔斯·坎贾马 (Charles Kanjama) 被允许入境。 坎贾马表示，卡鲁亚被封锁“尤其令人担忧”，尽管她与自己“出于同样的事情并以同样的专业身份”旅行。 “很难理解为什么辩护小组的一名成员应该被接纳，而另一名成员却被拒绝，”他在 X 上的一篇帖子中说道，同时呼吁乌干达当局解释他们的行为。 乌干达移民当局尚未回应英国广播公司的置评请求。 卢克瓦戈上周三出庭，在家中被捕几天后，他看上去很虚弱。 他否认了未能报告与贝西杰案有关的叛国罪的指控，并被还押在监狱中。 贝西杰自在肯尼亚被绑架以来一直因叛国罪入狱，并于 2024 年底被强行送回乌干达。他及其助手奥贝德·卢塔莱 (Obeid Lutale) 的绑架引发了有关法律管辖权和人权的激烈地区辩论。 肯尼亚律师协会周一表示支持“东非各地的法律界人士，他们在困难的情况下继续维护正义事业”。 它呼吁有关当局澄清卡鲁亚被拒绝进入乌干达的情况。 卡鲁阿在最终获准代表贝西杰之前遇到了几个障碍，包括她最初申请在乌干达担任律师被拒绝。 去年，她还被坦桑尼亚驱逐出境，以阻止她参加反对党领袖通杜·利苏的法庭审理，后者也面临叛国罪指控。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

reflection.en: The auction of iconic guitars, instruments that shaped a generation's sound, reminds us of the transient nature of even the most celebrated earthly achievements. While these instruments hold immense cultural value, Yahweh's word invites us to consider what truly endures beyond any perishable crown or fleeting fame.
reflection.zh: 这些塑造了一代人音乐的标志性吉他被拍卖，提醒我们即使是最受赞誉的世俗成就也终将消逝。尽管这些乐器具有巨大的文化价值，雅伟的话语却邀请我们思考，超越任何会朽坏的冠冕或短暂的名声，真正永恒的是什么。

verse.textEn: Everyone who competes in the games goes into strict training. They do it to get a crown that will not last, but we do it to get a crown that will last forever.
verse.textZh: 凡较力争胜的，诸事都有节制，他们不过是要得能坏的冠冕；我们却是要得不能坏的冠冕。

title.en: Alan Greenspan, architect of the modern American economy, dies aged 100
title.zh: 现代美国经济的建筑师艾伦·格林斯潘去世，享年 100 岁

summary.en: As chairman of the Federal Reserve, Alan Greenspan became the world's most high-profile banker.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Former US Federal Reserve chair Alan Greenspan has died aged 100, his wife has said.

NBC News correspondent Andrea Mitchell said in a statement reported by her employer that her husband had died from complications of Parkinson's Disease.

Mitchell's statement said Greenspan was "a giant of a man who helped shape the US economy for decades under presidents of both parties, but was always honest in acknowledging his mistakes".

For nearly 20 years, Alan Greenspan was charged with safeguarding the US economy and keeping the dollar sound.

As chairman of the Federal Reserve from 1987-2006, a post described as the second most important after the presidency, he presided over the longest sustained period of US economic growth in a generation.

Described as the "God in the machine" of American finance, Greenspan declined all requests for interviews during his time at the Fed.

But the media and the money markets hung on his few public statements, and a sign in his office said simply, "the buck starts here".

But critics argue that an over-reliance on easy credit fuelled the dot-com bubble of the late 1990s and caused the sub-prime mortgage crisis of 2008.

Alan Greenspan was born in New York City on 6 March 1926. His mother, who worked in a furniture store, brought him up single-handed.

Far from being a budding economist, the young Greenspan was a talented musician, who studied the clarinet at New York's renowned Julliard School of Music.

He played in a band with Stan Getz, the legendary jazz saxophonist, before touring the country with the Henry Jerome Band. This peripatetic lifestyle gave him a valuable practical insight into the workings of US business.

And while his fellow musicians spent their evenings smoking marijuana, Alan Greenspan busied himself by swotting up on economics and doing the band's accounts.

At the age of 19, he enrolled as an economics student at New York University, where he became an apostle of the free market, and eventually found employment as an economic consultant and, later, as a member of the board at JP Morgan.

In 1952, Greenspan met the right-wing novelist and social philosopher Ayn Rand, whose views were to have a profound influence on him.

But the young economist came to support her belief that society functions most efficiently when people actively pursue their own self-interests, to the exclusion of the interests of society as a whole.

In an article he wrote in 1966, he declared "the welfare state" as "nothing more than a mechanism by which governments confiscate the wealth of the productive members of a society".

Having successfully predicted the Eisenhower recession, Greenspan advised Richard Nixon during his successful presidential election campaign in 1968.

body.zh: 美联储前主席艾伦·格林斯潘 (Alan Greenspan) 的妻子表示，他已去世，享年 100 岁。 NBC 新闻记者安德里亚·米切尔 (Andrea Mitchell) 在雇主报道的一份声明中表示，她的丈夫死于帕金森病并发症。 米切尔的声明称，格林斯潘是“一位伟人，在两党总统的领导下几十年来帮助塑造了美国经济，但始终诚实地承认自己的错误”。 近20年来，艾伦·格林斯潘肩负着保护美国经济和保持美元稳健的重任。 1987年至2006年担任美联储主席（这一职位被称为仅次于总统职位的第二重要职位），他主持了美国一代人以来持续时间最长的经济增长时期。 格林斯潘被称为美国金融界的“机器中的上帝”，他在美联储任职期间拒绝了所有采访请求。 但媒体和金融市场都对他为数不多的公开声明表示关注，他办公室里的一块牌子简单地写着：“责任从这里开始”。 但批评者认为，对宽松信贷的过度依赖助长了 20 世纪 90 年代末的互联网泡沫，并引发了 2008 年的次贷危机。 艾伦·格林斯潘 (Alan Greenspan) 1926 年 3 月 6 日出生于纽约市。他的母亲在一家家具店工作，独自抚养他长大。 年轻的格林斯潘远不是一位崭露头角的经济学家，而是一位才华横溢的音乐家，他在纽约著名的茱莉亚音乐学院学习单簧管。 在与亨利·杰罗姆乐队一起在全国巡演之前，他与传奇爵士萨克斯管演奏家斯坦·盖茨一起在乐队中演奏。这种四处游历的生活方式使他对美国商业运作有了宝贵的实际见解。 当他的音乐家同事们晚上吸食大麻时，艾伦·格林斯潘却忙于研究经济学和做乐队的账目。 19 岁时，他就读于纽约大学经济学系，在那里他成为了自由市场的传播者，并最终找到了一份经济顾问的工作，后来成为摩根大通的董事会成员。 1952年，格林斯潘结识了右翼小说家、社会哲学家艾因·兰德，后者的观点对他产生了深远的影响。 但这位年轻的经济学家开始支持她的信念，即当人们积极追求自身利益、排除整个社会的利益时，社会才能最有效地运转。 他在 1966 年撰写的一篇文章中宣称，“福利国家”“只不过是政府没收社会生产性成员财富的一种机制”。 格林斯潘成功预测了艾森豪威尔经济衰退，并在 1968 年成功竞选总统期间为理查德·尼克松提供了建议。 格林斯潘后来写道，他找到了总统……

title.en: First round of US-Iran talks ends with encouraging progress, mediators say
title.zh: 美国和伊朗在瑞士开始初步和平协议谈判

summary.en: US and Iranian officials have begun face-to-face talks in Switzerland to negotiate an initial peace deal. This meeting follows recent fighting in Lebanon and Iran's claim to have closed the Strait of Hormuz.
summary.zh: 美国和伊朗官员已在瑞士开始面对面会谈，以谈判一项初步和平协议。此次会晤是在黎巴嫩持续冲突以及伊朗声称关闭霍尔木兹海峡之后进行的。

body.en:
The first round of negotiations between the US and Iran to reach a final deal to end the war has ended with "encouraging progress", mediators Qatar and Pakistan say.

In a joint statement early on Monday, Qatar and Pakistan said that the parties had agreed to "a roadmap towards reaching a final deal within 60 days".

Iran's foreign minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi said there had been "major progress" towards ending the conflict in Lebanon.

The memorandum of understanding (MoU) signed last week includes a commitment to ending the fighting on "all fronts" - including Lebanon - and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

"Pakistani and Qatari mediation has delivered major progress to end Lebanon War," Araghchi posted on social media.

"Oil and petrochem exports are waived, blockade lifted, some frozen assets released, and major reconstruction & development plan launched for Iran."

The Iranian lead negotiators left the talks in Switzerland on Monday, Iranian media said, with technical discussions between the parties due to continue.

The mediators' joint statement said that a "communication line" had been formed "to avoid incidents and miscommunication with the aim of safe passage for commercial vessels through the Strait of Hormuz".

Both sides also agreed to the creation of a "de-confliction cell" between the US, Iran and Lebanon, facilitated by the mediating countries, to end military operations in Lebanon, their statement said.

Lebanese President Joseph Aoun spoke to senior officials from the US and Qatar on Monday about the issue, and more broadly about consolidating a ceasefire in Lebanon, his office said.

Since the MoU was signed, there has been an upsurge in fighting between Lebanese armed group Hezbollah and Israeli forces in southern Lebanon, and Israeli air strikes that the health ministry says have killed dozens of Lebanese including women and children.

A new ceasefire between Israel and Hezbollah was declared on Friday. Continued clashes and air strikes prompted Iran on Saturday to announce it had shut the Strait of Hormuz, though tracking data shows vessels have continued to pass through it.

Hezbollah said it was committed to the ceasefire but that it would confront any attempt by Israel to "seize territory or expand its occupation".

The group said its fighters had clashed with Israeli forces advancing towards the Ali al-Taher hill area, which is on the edge of the southern village of Kfar Tebnit and overlooks the major town of Nabatieh in the south.

The Israeli military's chief of staff said on Sunday that Hezbollah had built an "underground military fortress" beneath the hill and that its destruction was one of the "primary operational focuses" of Israeli forces.

body.zh: 上周签署结束战争的初步协议后，美国和伊朗官员在瑞士开始直接会谈。 该协议包括承诺在 60 天内达成最终协议，以及结束“所有战线”（包括黎巴嫩）的战斗以及重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。 但以色列和伊朗支持的黎巴嫩真主党之间发生的更多冲突促使伊朗宣布周六关闭了这条航线——尽管跟踪数据显示船只继续通过该航线。 会谈开始后，唐纳德·特朗普总统在社交媒体上表示，伊朗“必须立即停止其在黎巴嫩的高薪代理人制造麻烦”。 会谈开始前，副总统万斯曾表示，美国希望在“核问题”和黎巴嫩问题上取得进展，而德黑兰则表示将“要求对方履行承诺”。 在瑞士度假胜地布尔根施托克，万斯表示，特朗普已要求谈判代表“翻开新的一页”。他补充说，如果伊朗领导层愿意放弃成为“地区不稳定的推动者”和“长期的核武器野心”，那么美国“愿意从根本上改变我们与该国的关系”。 伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴卡伊(Esmaeil Baqaei)在一份声明中表示，最终协议的谈判取决于执行现有承诺，包括停止所有军事行动。他说，周日的会谈重点是实施。 特朗普的女婿贾里德·库什纳和特使史蒂夫·威特科夫也加入了万斯的行列。 对于伊朗人来说，议长穆罕默德·巴格尔·加利巴夫和外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇于周六晚抵达瑞士。 巴基斯坦总理谢赫巴兹·谢里夫和该国武装部队总司令阿西姆·穆尼尔元帅与代表团一起出席。 巴基斯坦在整个战争期间充当调解人，并主持了美国和伊朗之间的上一轮谈判。 美国和伊朗总统本周早些时候签署了初步协议，旨在立即结束战争。 根据协议，伊朗将重新开放霍尔木兹海峡，这是全球 20% 的石油和天然气运输的主要运输通道。它的有效关闭推高了燃油价格并扰乱了全球经济。 美国还同意解除对进出伊朗港口的船只的军事封锁。 最初的协议还包括一项价值3000亿美元（2240亿英镑）的伊朗“重建”计划，以及美国终止对其的“所有类型的制裁”。 但美国所说的冲突主要原因——伊朗核计划问题仍有待谈判。在特朗普的第一个任期内，他让美国退出了奥巴马时代与伊朗的核协议，并重新实施了经济制裁……

title.en: Late singer Oliver Tree's body returned to US after helicopter crash
title.zh: 已故歌手奥利弗·树 (Oliver Tree) 的遗体在直升机坠毁后返回美国

summary.en: The 32-year-old California native died whilst on his world tour, ahead of a date in Brazil.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The body of US singer-songwriter Oliver Tree has been returned home to California, with an Instagram post on his account saying "he can finally rest".

Tree and six others died in a helicopter crash over Rio de Janeiro last week, when it collided with another helicopter.

The social media post also said his family would be honouring his "final wish" by setting up a charity in his name.

"This is something that Oliver had put together before his passing, written in his will. We will make sure his wish comes to fruition so that more joy, love and art can be spread into the world, that was his final wish," the statement also said.

The foundation will be named Dr. Oliver Tree's Extremely Epic Grant For Baby Geniuses. The rest of the post thanked fans for their "constant love, support and positivity" shown to the family and friends of the musician and social media personality during "these extremely difficult times".

"Love you all so much, Oliver would be so proud of every one of his supporters, friends and family. Peace be with Oliver," it also said.

Tree - born Oliver Tree Nickell in Santa Cruz, California in 1993 - first rose to fame in 2016 after going viral on social media.

With his distinctive bowl haircut, he was known for hits including Life Goes On, Miss You and Alien Boy.

Tree, who died at the age of 32, had just begun a world tour, with his most recent show in São Paulo, Brazil on 6 June. He was next scheduled to perform in Lisbon, in Portugal, on 1 July and had been due to play dates in Glasgow, Manchester and London in September.
body.zh: 美国创作型歌手奥利弗·特里的遗体已被送回加利福尼亚州的家中，他的 Instagram 账户上发帖称“他终于可以休息了”。 上周，特里和其他六人在里约热内卢上空的一次直升机坠毁事故中丧生，当时直升机与另一架直升机相撞。 社交媒体帖子还表示，他的家人将通过以他的名义设立一个慈善机构来实现他的“最终愿望”。 声明还说：“这是奥利弗去世前写在遗嘱中的东西。我们将确保他的愿望实现，让更多的欢乐、爱和艺术能够传播到世界上，这是他最后的愿望。” 该基金会将被命名为奥利弗·树博士的天才宝贝极其史诗基金。帖子的其余部分感谢歌迷在“这些极其困难的时期”向这位音乐家的家人和朋友以及社交媒体人物表现出的“持续的爱、支持和积极态度”。 声明还写道：“非常爱你们所有人，奥利弗将为他的每一位支持者、朋友和家人感到骄傲。愿奥利弗平安。” Tree 奥利弗·特里·尼克尔 (Oliver Tree Nickell) 1993 年出生于加利福尼亚州圣克鲁斯，2016 年在社交媒体上走红后首次声名鹊起。 凭借其独特的碗形发型，他因《Life Goes On》、《Miss You》和《Alien Boy》等热门歌曲而闻名。 享年 32 岁的 Tree 刚刚开始世界巡演，他最近的一场演出于 6 月 6 日在巴西圣保罗举行。他的下一场演出原定于 7 月 1 日在葡萄牙里斯本举行，并计划于 9 月在格拉斯哥、曼彻斯特和伦敦演出。

title.en: UK prime minister Keir Starmer announces resignation following months of party pressure
title.zh: 英国首相凯尔·斯塔默在党内压力数月后宣布辞职

summary.en: The UK prime minister said he would do everything in his power to ensure an orderly transition of power.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Prime Minister Keir Starmer said on Monday he would resign, with a new leader to be in place by the time parliament returns in September, paving the way for Britain to have its seventh leader in 10 years.

In an emotional speech, Starmer said he had listened to his governing Labour Party and realised that he was no longer the man who should lead it into a national election due in 2029.

After spending weeks saying he would fight any challenge to his position as prime minister, Starmer spent the weekend reflecting on his political future at his country residence, watching support for him in the party drain away.

In Downing Street, outside his office and London residence, Starmer said he would ask the Labour Party's organising committee to set out a timeline for a leadership contest to find his replacement.

Nominations would open on 9 July, close by mid-July, and if there is a contest, a new leader will be in place by September. He did not mention his rival, Andy Burnham, who is widely expected to replace him.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"The question my party is asking now is whether I am best placed to lead us into the next general election. I have heard the answer from my parliamentary party to that question and I accept that answer with good grace," he said.

After describing the achievements his government had secured in his two years of power, a man who was often criticised for being robotic, became visibly emotional, his voice cracking when he thanked his family for their support.

"When I leave the biggest job in the country I will spend more time on the most important job, being the best husband I can to my fantastic wife Vic who has been a rock by my side through good times and bad, and being the best dad I can to my beautiful children who are my pride and my joy."

Whoever replaces Starmer will become Britain's seventh prime minister since the Brexit vote to leave the European Union which took place 10 years ago this week.

That level of turnover — the highest in Britain in nearly two centuries — underlines the struggle of maintaining the support of voters angry at successive failures to improve living standards, public services and tackle illegal immigration.

title.en: Europe's 'Trump whisperer' was its bridge to the White House. Now that bridge is cracking

body.en:
When Donald Trump returned to the White House last year, Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni was the only European leader to attend the inauguration.

Seventeen months later, their relationship is publicly breaking down, as the two right-wing leaders trade barbs on social media.

Trump's relationships with traditional European allies have further strained in his second term, and he's become increasingly unpopular among voters in much of Western Europe.

He's clashed with leaders including Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz over his decision to go to war with Iran.

And earlier this year, he shattered trust within the NATO military alliance with threats to take over Greenland.

The deterioration of the relationship with Meloni raises questions about who, if anyone, still has the US president's ear in Europe.

Meloni was viewed as one of the few leaders capable of acting as a bridge between Trump and Europe, dubbed a "Trump whisperer" by some commentators.

But cracks appeared after the US and Israel started a war with Iran earlier this year, triggering global oil price surges , damaging European economies and igniting strong anti-war sentiment in Italy.

In April, Trump lashed out at Pope Leo XIV after the pontiff denounced the war in the Middle East, criticised Trump's threat to destroy Iranian civilisation , and called on the US president to find an "off-ramp" to end the conflict.

Facing domestic pressure at the time, Meloni said Trump's comments about the pope were "unacceptable", prompting a rebuke from Trump.

Italy had also denied the use of an airbase in Sicily to US military planes carrying weapons for the war in Iran, saying the Americans had not followed the necessary procedures.

To onlookers at the G7 summit in France last week, Trump and Meloni appeared as though they might have reconciled.

That impression was short-lived. On Friday, Italian TV channel La7 quoted Trump as saying Meloni "begged me to take a picture with her".

"I wouldn't have taken it, but I felt sorry for her," Trump said, according to the broadcaster's translation.

Responding in a video on social media, Meloni said Trump's statements were fabricated.

"I am frankly astonished. I don't know why the president of the United States behaves like this towards his allies. It is not the first time," she said.

"It is disappointing that he does not show the same determination with the enemies of the West and of the United States, whose leaders he instead treats with far greater indulgence. Neither I nor Italy ever beg."

title.en: Europe prepares for extreme heat as France issues red alerts

summary.en: European authorities are implementing restrictions and preparing for extreme heat as temperatures continue to rise across the continent.

body.en:
A punishing heatwave sweeping across Europe is prompting governments to impose restrictions, issue warnings and reshape daily life as temperatures climb towards record levels.

France is preparing for temperatures of up to 41C, with 35 of the country's 96 regions expected to move onto red heatwave alerts stretching from the southwest through Paris and into Burgundy.

After a crisis meeting, French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu announced restrictions on alcohol consumption at public events, including the annual Fête de la Musique celebrations across affected regions.

Authorities in Paris have also ordered parks to remain open around the clock to help residents escape the heat.

Elsewhere, heat alerts were issued across most of Germany as temperatures approached 38C.

Germany's national weather service warned that a combination of high temperatures and humidity could increase the risk of severe thunderstorms.

In Spain, authorities closed a World Cup fan zone in Madrid's Plaza de Colón that had been set up with giant screens for supporters to watch Spain's match against Saudi Arabia .

Parts of Spain remain under heat warnings, with some outdoor sporting and cultural activities suspended.

In Italy, authorities expanded heat warnings across several cities as temperatures pushed into the high 30s.

Across southern Europe, the heat has reportedly begun altering how residents and tourists move through cities.

In Rome, visitors queued in the sun outside the Colosseum while others sought relief in cooler underground spaces beneath the remains of the Temple of Claudius.

In Bologna, among Italy's hottest cities, people cooled off at the Fountain of Neptune and sheltered beneath shaded porticoes.

French authorities increased staffing across rail services amid concerns that extreme temperatures could affect infrastructure, including tracks and electrical systems.

Officials have also tightened monitoring around water supplies and bushfire conditions.

The government ordered hundreds of schools to close ahead of expected peak temperatures.

Scientists say climate change is making heatwaves more frequent and intense across Europe, increasing risks to public health and economic activity.

Bank of France governor Emmanuel Moulin said the short-term impact on growth was mixed, with reduced productivity offset in part by higher energy demand, but warned that prolonged periods of extreme heat weigh on economies over time.

Health authorities have also renewed warnings around heat exhaustion and heat stroke, particularly for older people and vulnerable communities.

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump has threatened to strike Iran over its support for Hezbollah.

The threat has cast uncertainty over the opening of high-stakes negotiations aimed at turning a fragile ceasefire into a longer-term peace agreement.

The warning came as senior US and Iranian officials gathered in Switzerland for the first round of talks aimed at building on a preliminary memorandum of understanding reached last week to end months of regional conflict.

Posting on Truth Social as negotiations got underway, Trump said Iran must "immediately stop their highly paid proxies in Lebanon from causing trouble".

"If they don’t, we’ll hit Iran very hard again, just like we did last week, only harder!!!" he wrote.

Iran responded swiftly with chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf warning the US to "be careful" with its language, saying Iran's armed forces were prepared to respond and insisting US threats had failed to alter Iran's position.

The heightened rhetoric briefly fuelled speculation that the negotiations could unravel before substantive discussions had begun.

Iranian state media reported Iran's delegation had left the venue in response to Trump's comments, with some outlets suggesting the talks had been suspended.

But that account was later called into question when a diplomat familiar with the negotiations told Agence France-Presse the Iranian delegation remained engaged and had not indicated to mediators any intention to withdraw.

The negotiations, mediated by Pakistan and Qatar at the Swiss resort of Bürgenstock, are intended to launch a 60-day process to negotiate a more permanent settlement and ease tensions across the region.

Iran said continued Israeli military activity and the implementation of commitments in Lebanon would dominate the opening round of talks.

The preliminary agreement signed last week committed both sides to ending hostilities across multiple fronts, including between Israel and Hezbollah.

Yet repeated clashes in southern Lebanon have raised doubts over whether that framework can hold.

Iran has insisted that meaningful progress towards a final agreement cannot happen while fighting continues.

The uncertainty around Lebanon was further complicated by comments from Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa, who publicly rejected suggestions his country could play a military role in the conflict.

Speaking to broadcaster Al Mashhad, Sharaa said Syria was focused on restoring economic ties and regional stability rather than intervening militarily.

"We are looking for economic channels between Lebanon and Syria, not military ones," he said.

President Nicusor Dan has nominated a new prime minister, without consulting Romania’s governing parties. Critics accuse Dan of breaking democratic rules.

Romanian President Nicusor Dan is a passionate chess player and, by all accounts, a rather good one, too. But now, amid Romania's ongoing political crisis, Dan has made a move that is not only risky but arguably breaks the rules of the democratic game.

Many are wondering what could have led Dan, a former civil society activist, to act this way.

Two months ago, Romania's four-party coalition collapsed , leaving the country without a government as the country finds itself amid severe financial and socioeconomic crisis.

In a surprise move on Sunday, Dan nominated Adrian Vestea of the National Liberal Party (PNL) as the new prime ministerial candidate, after the previous candidate had withdrawn.

Vestea, who currently serves as president of Brasov county council, does not however have the best track record. He graduated from a university of questionable academic standards, and later failed to have the access roads to a major Romanian NATO military base repaired, among other things.

Dan made his nomination without first consulting the parties in parliament, as required by the constitution. Not only that. The president nominated Vestea without the leadership his own PNL party knowing.

PNL Chairman Ilie Bolojan, who heads the current government as interim prime minister, called Vestea's nomination a "hostile act" and an "attempt to divide the PNL."

Romania is under pressure to implement fundamental administrative and tax reforms, and overhaul its judicial system, which is regarded as corrupt. Without these measures, Romania faces the threat of a severe financial crisis and of losing out on many billions of euros in EU funding. Romania's political elite, however, has been reluctant to make changes.

Romania's Social Democrats (PSD), which was initially composed of former communist officials from the Ceausescu dictatorship, today predominantly champions right-wing nationalist positions. Pro-Russian far-right parties have also gained traction in recent years against the backdrop of Romania's gridlocked reforms and the growing disillusionment with its corrupt political establishment. Abiy Ahmed will remain Ethiopia's prime minister after his party won the elections yet again. Since taking office in 2018, he has attracted both strong supporters and fierce critics, reflecting his polarizing leadership.

Abiy Ahmed is likely to continue his role as Ethiopia's prime minister after his Prosperity Party won another comfortable parliamentary majority in the June 1 elections . The party took nearly 90% of seats.

The results were released on Sunday after voting in several polling stations was suspended due to security issues, and no voting took place in northern Tigray for a second consecutive election. Abiy is now awaiting the formality of election by the House of Peoples' Representatives.

Abiy burst onto the world stage as a young, dynamic leader of Ethiopia in 2018. But his journey to the top job began long before that.

In the 1990s, he had a career with the Ethiopian National Defense Force (ENDF), before leading Ethiopia's cyber-intelligence service INSA. He first became known nationally as a politician in 2010, when he rose through the ranks of the Oromo People's Democratic Organization (OPDO). In 2018, the party changed its name to Oromo Democratic Party (ODP).

He was subsequently elected to the House of Representatives, and in 2016 became the Minister of Science and Technology in Addis Ababa. However, he soon returned to his home province of Oromia to serve as head of the OPDO Secretariat.

Abiy Ahmed's meteoric rise came in 2018, when he became one of the nation's youngest-ever leaders. But it was not just his youth that excited so many, it was also what he represented.

Born to a Muslim father and a Christian mother in 1976 in western Ethiopia, Abiy became the first Oromo chairman of the ruling four-party coalition, the Ethiopian People's Revolutionary Democratic Front (EPRDF). 

His appointment signaled a shift in Ethiopian politics, because although Oromos make up around a third of Ethiopia's approximately 136 million citizens, Tigrayans had dominated the country politically until then.

The Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF), the dominant party in the EPRDF, had until that point exerted a sizable influence on Ethiopia's political and economic fortunes since the fall of the Mengistu Haile Mariam-led military regime in 1991. The TPLF also controlled the ENDF and intelligence services.

But it was Abiy's overtures to neighboring Eritrea , with whom Ethiopia had fought a bloody war between 1998 and 2000 that claimed more than 80,000 lives, that garnered him international attention.

summary.en: Five people were injured in the attacks on Friday that were described by Prime Minister Keir Starmer as being motivated by "anti-Muslim hatred."
summary.zh: 周五发生的袭击事件造成五人受伤，首相基尔·斯塔默称这些袭击是出于“反穆斯林仇恨”。

body.en:
Five people were injured in the attacks on Friday that were described by Prime Minister Keir Starmer as being motivated by "anti-Muslim hatred."

Scottish  police on Sunday said they had charged a 36-year-old man in connection with a series of attacks in Edinburgh on Friday .

"A 36-year-old man has been charged in connection with a number of incidents which took place in Edinburgh on Friday, 19 June, 2026," the Scottish police statement read.

"A report has been submitted to the procurator fiscal, and the individual will appear at court in due course.”

On Saturday, British Prime Minister Keir Starmer said that the attacks appeared to be motivated by " anti-Muslim hatred ."

"Absolutely appalling. No one should face violence on our streets," Starmer said in a post on X.

 "The suspect appears to be motivated by anti-Muslim hatred. I will not tolerate this – he will face the full force of the law."

 "There is no place for violence, racism or intolerance in our country. I met community groups last week to assure them of the strong support of the Government.”

On Friday, police said that they had responded to reports of "violent attacks including threats, robbery and vandalism" across the city and that counterterrorism police had launched a probe into the incidents

Police closed off the major Leith Walk road that connects the city center to the Leith coastal suburb.

British media reported the attacks appeared to have begun near a mosque in western Edinburgh and continued through other parts of the city.

Footage on social media appeared to show a shirtless man walking along the street carrying a weapon, and with another video showing him being restrained by police and shouting about "protecting the country."

Some five people were injured in the attacks, including three that required hospital treatment.

The incidents come amid a wave of anti-Muslim and anti- migrant sentiment in Britain, including riots in the Northern Irish capital of Belfast and in other cities.

summary.en: Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s Prosperity Party comfortably secured another parliamentary majority, defeating a fragmented opposition.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s Prosperity Party comfortably secured another parliamentary majority, defeating a fragmented opposition.

Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed's Prosperity Party has secured a landslide majority, according to election results released Sunday by the National Elections Board (NEBE), .

"The ruling Prosperity Party secured 438 of the 486 seats in the House of Peoples' Representatives," Melatwork Hailu, chairperson of the NEBE, announced.

The June 1 legislative elections went ahead, despite voting not taking place in parts of the country, including areas in the Tigray and Amhara and Oromia regions.

More than 40 parties ran against Ahmed's Prosperity Party, but most lacked funding, and the ruling party was unopposed in 64 constituencies . The best-represented rival, Ezema, fielded 293 candidates, compared with the Prosperity Party's 461.

"The party's victory accounts for roughly 90 percent of the contested seats," the NEBE said.

The outcome will likely give Abiy, who has been in power since 2018, another five years in office, as the legislature elects the prime minister.

Some analysts say the suspension of voting in parts of Amhara, Oromia, and Tigray highlights the impact of unresolved conflicts.

"I hope they use the coming five years to really bring what the majority of the country really needs and deserves, which is peace and security," analyst Bizuneh Yimenu previously told DW.

Ethiopia has been rocked by multiple ethnic nationalist insurgencies, with rebel groups still active in multiple regions.

The northern Tigray region was the site of a 2020-2022 armed  conflict between the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) and the Ethiopian army .

The Amhara region has seen clashes between the federal government and Amhara nationalist militias known as the Fano, while Oromia is home to the Oromo Liberation Army (OLA) rebels.

summary.en: Taiwan's agriculture ministry is worried that Beijing wants to weaponise a local specialty: the atemoya.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A scaly, heart-shaped fruit could become the latest cause of friction between China and Taiwan, as the latter warned farmers against Beijing's plan to step up imports of the crop.

The atemoya, a hybrid of different custard apple species with creamy white flesh encased in a rough green exterior, is a specialty of Taiwan's Taitung county.

China, a key importer of Taiwanese atemoyas, pledged to buy more of the fruit earlier this month.

But a press release by Taiwan's agriculture ministry on Saturday claimed this was a "classic example of China's 'raise, trap, kill' process", by which Beijing creates reliance before leaving farmers exposed to market changes.

Beijing claims the self-governed island of Taiwan as its territory and has not ruled out taking it by force. In recent years it has stepped up military drills near Taiwan, including simulating blockades on the island.

Observers say China has also engaged in a range of non-military tactics to pressure Taiwan. And one apparent weapon is fruit.

In 2021, China banned the import of Taiwanese pineapples , causing major disruption to farmers' livelihoods. This sparked a domestic consumption movement to counter what many Taiwanese saw as economic coercion.

"First, China makes large purchases to show goodwill and encourage farmers to grow atemoyas. Next it unilaterally imposes export restrictions without warning," the Taiwanese agriculture ministry said in its press release.

The statement noted that China suspended imports of atemoyas in 2021, citing pest concerns, before partially resuming imports in 2023 and then slapping taxes on the fruit in 2024.

Such moves "cause the industry to face huge instability and farmers to bear great risks," the ministry said.

It added that China has also been expanding its own atemoya cultivation, posing a threat to Taiwan's local industry.

The growing debate over the export of Taiwanese atemoyas started earlier this month, after Chinese companies pledged to buy more of the fruit at a forum in China's Xiamen city - a coastal city on the Taiwan Strait. This was part of a broader plan to expand purchases of Taiwanese exports to China, including fish and tea.

The forum was attended by business leaders and opposition politicians from Taiwan, despite an official ban on participation by Taiwan's central government.

Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council spokesperson has since warned that officials who attended the forum could be investigated.

In its statement, Taiwan's agriculture ministry said authorities would focus on "sustainable agricultural development and stable income for farmers", and "continue to guide the atemoya industry toward diversified processing", including by producing frozen fruit products, puree and wines.

body.zh: 这种有鳞的心形水果可能成为中国大陆和台湾之间摩擦的最新原因，后者警告农民反对北京增加该作物进口的计划。 阿特莫亚是不同番荔枝品种的杂交品种，其果肉呈乳白色，外表呈粗糙的绿色，是台湾台东县的特产。 中国是台湾阿特莫亚的主要进口国，本月早些时候承诺购买更多这种水果。 但台湾农业部周六发布的一份新闻稿称，这是“中国‘饲养、诱捕、宰杀’过程的典型例子”，北京通过这种方式在农民面临市场变化之前创造了依赖。 北京声称自治的台湾岛是其领土，并且不排除以武力夺取它的可能性。近年来，它加强了在台湾附近的军事演习，包括模拟封锁台湾岛。 观察人士称，中国还采取了一系列非军事策略向台湾施压。水果是一种明显的武器。 2021年，中国禁止进口台湾菠萝，对农民生计造成重大破坏。这引发了一场国内消费运动，以对抗许多台湾人所认为的经济胁迫。 台湾农业部在新闻稿中表示：“首先，中国进行大量采购以显示善意并鼓励农民种植特莫亚。接下来，中国在没有警告的情况下单方面实施出口限制。” 声明指出，中国以害虫问题为由，于 2021 年暂停了阿特莫亚的进口，然后于 2023 年部分恢复进口，并于 2024 年对该水果征税。 该部表示，此类举措“导致行业面临巨大不稳定，农民承受巨大风险”。 报告补充说，中国大陆也一直在扩大自己的阿特莫亚种植规模，对台湾当地产业构成威胁。 本月早些时候，中国企业在中国台湾海峡沿海城市厦门市举行的一次论坛上承诺购买更多台湾特莫亚水果后，关于台湾特莫亚果出口的争论开始日益激烈。这是扩大台湾对中国出口产品（包括鱼和茶）采购的更广泛计划的一部分。 尽管台湾中央政府正式禁止参加该论坛，但仍有来自台湾的商界领袖和反对派政界人士参加。 台湾陆委会发言人此后警告称，出席论坛的官员可能会受到调查。 台湾农业部在声明中表示，当局将重点关注“农业可持续发展和农民稳定收入”，并“继续引导阿特莫亚产业走向多元化加工”，包括生产冷冻水果产品、果泥和葡萄酒。 但反对党议员...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to peace-making and restraint. Matthew 5:9 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with mercy, truth, and restraint, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到和平与克制。Matthew 5:9提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以怜悯、真实与节制来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: ‘A hunting ground for foreign regimes’: why violent attacks on dissidents are on the rise in Britain
title.zh: “外国政权的猎场”：为何针对异议人士的暴力袭击在英国日益增多

summary.en: Reports indicate a rise in violent attacks on dissidents living in the UK, with Iran and China accused of targeting critics. An arson attack on Prime Minister Keir Starmer’s properties has also been linked to Russia.
summary.zh: 报道指出，居住在英国的异议人士遭受的暴力袭击有所增加，伊朗和中国被指控针对批评者。针对首相基尔·斯塔默房产的纵火袭击也被认为与俄罗斯有关。

body.en: Iran and China among those accused of targeting critics living in the UK, as arson attack on prime minister Keir Starmer’s properties linked to Russia As Pouria Zeraati was crossing the street between his Wimbledon home and his car in south London in March 2024, he was confronted by two men. One held him firmly as the other stabbed him three times in the leg before they both fled. It was later said to be a targeted attack on behalf of the Iranian regime in Tehran. A punishment for Zeraati’s work as a journalist covering Iran . He survived, but the ambush is one of dozens of violent incidents in recent years linked to foreign states. Russia, China, India, Saudi Arabia and Iran have all been blamed for targeting critics and dissidents living in the UK in the past decade, and linked to incidents involving physical assaults, attempted kidnap, stabbings and an acid attack. Continue reading...
body.zh: 伊朗和中国被指控针对居住在英国的批评者，对首相基尔·斯塔默与俄罗斯有关的财产进行纵火袭击。 2024 年 3 月，当普里亚·泽拉蒂 (Pouria Zeraati) 在伦敦南部温布尔登的家和他的汽车之间过马路时，遇到了两名男子。一个人牢牢地抓住了他，另一个人则在他的腿上刺了三刀，然后他们就逃跑了。后来据称这是针对德黑兰伊朗政权的一次有针对性的袭击。对泽拉蒂作为报道伊朗的记者的惩罚。他幸存下来，但这次伏击是近年来与外国有关的数十起暴力事件之一。俄罗斯、中国、印度、沙特阿拉伯和伊朗都被指责在过去十年中针对居住在英国的批评者和持不同政见者，并与涉及人身攻击、企图绑架、刺伤和硫酸袭击的事件有关。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This report highlights the chilling reality of oppressive regimes extending their reach to silence critics abroad. Proverbs 28:15 reminds us that a wicked ruler can be like a dangerous predator to a helpless people, illustrating the vulnerability of those who speak truth to power. In such times, we pray for the safety of dissidents and for justice to...
reflection.zh: 这篇报道揭示了压迫性政权将魔爪伸向海外，以压制批评者的严峻现实。箴言28:15提醒我们，邪恶的统治者对无助的人民来说，如同咆哮的狮子或冲锋的熊，这形象地描绘了那些向权力说真话的人所面临的脆弱处境。在这样的时刻，我们为异议人士的安全祷告，并祈求公义战胜那些试图压制自由的势力。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Petrol prices in Australia are now lower than before the Iran war began. Is the oil crisis over and what happens next?
title.zh: 澳大利亚汽油价格已低于伊朗战争爆发前水平。石油危机结束了吗？接下来会发生什么？

summary.en: Australian petrol prices have fallen below pre-Middle East conflict levels, surprising analysts who had warned of shortages and record high prices. This unexpected flexibility from non-Middle Eastern fuel suppliers, including China, has led to a significant drop in costs.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚的汽油价格已降至中东冲突爆发前的水平，这出乎分析师的意料，他们此前曾警告可能出现燃料短缺和价格飙升。中东以外的燃料供应商，包括中国，展现出超出预期的灵活性，导致油价显著下降。

body.en: Fuel suppliers outside the Middle East have proved to be much more flexible than analysts expected – and China surprised everyone Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australians were warned soon after the Middle East conflict started that the country could run short on fuel, with prices rising to record levels owing to disrupted oil supplies. Now, amid an uneasy peace deal and continued supply disruptions, petrol prices are lower than they were before the conflict began and official warnings over fuel usage have largely disappeared. Continue reading...
body.zh: 事实证明，中东以外的燃料供应商比分析师预期的灵活得多，而中国令所有人感到惊讶。中东冲突爆发后不久，澳大利亚人就收到警告称，该国可能出现燃料短缺，由于石油供应中断，价格上涨至创纪录水平。现在，由于和平协议不稳定，供应持续中断，汽油价格低于冲突开始前，官方对燃料使用的警告也基本消失。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unexpected drop in petrol prices, after initial warnings of scarcity and record highs, reminds us that periods of anxiety can give way to relief. Just as weeping may endure for a night, joy can indeed come in the morning, often through unforeseen circumstances. This turn of events offers a hopeful perspective on how challenges can resolve in ways we...
reflection.zh: 汽油价格在最初警告可能出现短缺和创纪录高位后，意外下降，这提醒我们，焦虑时期可能会迎来缓解。正如哭泣可能持续一夜，喜乐确实会在早晨到来，而且常常是通过意想不到的情况。这一转变提供了一个充满希望的视角，说明挑战可能以我们未曾预料的方式得到解决。

verse.textEn: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
verse.textZh: 一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。

title.en: Charging ahead: EVs outpace growth predictions
title.zh: 电动汽车：超越增长预期，加速前进

summary.en: Electric vehicles are becoming more affordable, efficient, and capable of longer distances, exceeding initial growth forecasts. China is leading this transition, with Europe and other nations rapidly advancing as well.
summary.zh: 电动汽车正变得更便宜、更高效，续航里程也比以往任何时候都长，其增长速度超出了预期。中国正在推动这一转型，而欧洲和其他国家也正在迅速追赶。

body.zh: 电动汽车变得越来越便宜、越来越高效，而且行驶距离比以往任何时候都更远。中国正在推动这一转型，但欧洲和其他国家正在快速追赶。 全球电动汽车 (EV) 市场的增长速度远远快于预期。短短六年内，销量增长了十倍，到 2025 年，全球电动汽车销量将达到约 2100 万辆。 中国和欧洲处于领先地位，但世界其他地区的市场也在快速增长。 中国长期以来一直在投资太阳能和风能以及电池技术——电动汽车最关键的组成部分。 得益于先进的研究和大规模生产，电动汽车电池成本大幅下降。如今，它们的成本仅为 10 年前的四分之一，而且价格还在继续下降。 中国是世界上最大的汽车市场，消费者正在从政府的产业战略中获益。自 2024 年以来，电动汽车的成本低于内燃机汽车，国家多年来一直在迅速扩大充电基础设施，而且中国的电力非常实惠。 2015年，电动汽车仅占中国新车销量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，这一比例已攀升至 61%。 电动汽车依靠电力运行并通过电缆充电。在全球范围内，三分之二的电动汽车是所谓的电池电动汽车 (BEV)，仅由电力驱动。剩下的三分之一还配备了燃气发动机，用于长途旅行时的备用——这些被称为增程电动汽车 (EREV) 或插电式混合动力电动汽车 (PHEV)。 相比之下，所谓的混合动力电动汽车 (HEV) 始终需要汽油或柴油来为其内燃机提供动力。电动机提供一些帮助，仅通过再生制动产生电力。这项技术在一定程度上降低了城市驾驶的燃油消耗，但混合动力汽车在国际统计中并未被算作电动汽车。 2018年，电动汽车仅占欧盟新车注册量的1%。到 2026 年 4 月，售出的新车中近三分之一是电动汽车。 北欧处于领先地位。在挪威，现在销售的几乎所有新车都是电动汽车（99%），其次是丹麦（82%）和瑞典（65%）。该地区各国政府支持气候友好型出行，并正在扩大充电基础设施。 在英国，2026 年 4 月注册的新车中有 39% 是电动汽车，其次是德国（37%）和法国（32%）。在这三个国家，电动汽车销量与去年同月相比都翻了一番。 近年来，美国市场陷入停滞。 2023 年至 2025 年间，电动汽车占...

reflection.en: The rapid advancements in electric vehicle technology, making them cheaper and more efficient, reflect a remarkable acceleration of human knowledge and innovation. This progress reminds us of the human capacity to explore and develop new solutions, continually expanding our understanding and capabilities.
reflection.zh: 电动汽车技术日新月异，变得更便宜、更高效，这反映了人类知识和创新的显著加速。这种进步提醒我们，人类有能力探索和开发新的解决方案，不断拓展我们的理解和能力。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: For women in China frustrated by sexism, female comics are offering a release
title.zh: 在中国，女性喜剧演员为厌倦性别歧视的女性提供宣泄出口

summary.en: Standup comedy in China is providing a platform for women to discuss sensitive topics, including sexism, offering a sense of release and shared experience. Performers, however, remain cautious of censorship limits as they navigate this space in venues like a small performing arts theatre in east Beijing.
summary.zh: 中国的脱口秀喜剧为女性提供了一个平台，让她们可以讨论包括性别歧视在内的敏感话题，从而获得宣泄和共同的体验。然而，表演者们在北京东部一家小型表演艺术剧院等场所进行表演时，仍对审查限制保持警惕。

body.en: Standup comedy gives women a space to talk about certain topics that have become more sensitive, while performers remain wary of censorship limits Packed into the upstairs theatre of a small performing arts space in east Beijing, more than 100 people, mostly women, are giddy with anticipation. “Who did you come to see?” asks the MC, fashionably dressed in a faded denim two-piece suit. The answer is bellowed in unison back to him: “Fang Zhuren!” Fang Shaoli, AKA Director Fang ( Fang Zhuren ), has built a cult following in China in the past two years. Decidedly less fashionable than the evening’s host, Fang is dressed in a yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans. Her everywoman attire is part of the appeal. With a stout frame and short, sensible haircut, Fang, who was born in 1975, hails from rural part of east China’s Shandong province. Before discovering the art of standup comedy she worked in factories and on construction sites, but mainly lived as a housewife to a difficult husband. Her jokes riff on the deep sexism that permeates Chinese culture, particularly away from the big urban centres like Beijing and Shanghai. Continue reading...
body.zh: 单口喜剧为女性提供了谈论某些变得更加敏感的话题的空间，而表演者们仍然对审查制度的限制保持警惕北京东部一个小型表演艺术空间的楼上剧场里，有 100 多人（其中大部分是女性）满怀期待。 “你是来看谁的？”身穿褪色牛仔两件套西装的主持人问道。对方齐声喊道：“方主任！”方绍立，又名方主任（方主任），过去两年在中国建立了一批狂热的追随者。方穿着黄色连帽衫和深蓝色牛仔裤，明显不如当晚主持人时尚。她的普通女性着装是其吸引力的一部分。方出生于1975年，来自中国东部山东省的农村地区，身材魁梧，留着一头漂亮的短发。在发现单口喜剧艺术之前，她曾在工厂和建筑工地工作过，但主要是作为一位难相处的丈夫的家庭主妇生活。她的笑话反复提及了渗透在中国文化中的根深蒂固的性别歧视，尤其是在远离北京和上海等大城市中心的地方。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story highlights the human need to express frustrations and experiences, especially when facing societal pressures like sexism. Proverbs 31:8-9 reminds us of the importance of speaking up for those whose voices are often unheard, advocating for justice and dignity. Even in challenging environments, creative expression can offer a vital space for shared...
reflection.zh: 这个故事突显了人类表达挫折和经历的需求，尤其是在面对性别歧视等社会压力时。箴言31:8-9提醒我们，为那些常常被忽视的声音发声，倡导公义和尊严是何等重要。即使在充满挑战的环境中，创造性的表达也能为共同的理解和释放提供一个重要的空间，这反映了雅伟对边缘群体的关怀。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Border Force officer and Hong Kong trade official jailed for spying for China
title.zh: 英国边境部队官员和香港贸易官员因替中国从事间谍活动被判入狱

summary.en: A UK Border Force officer and a Hong Kong trade official have been sentenced to 10 and eight years in prison, respectively, after being convicted of spying for China. These are the first convictions under the UK's National Security Act.
summary.zh: 一名英国边境部队官员和一名香港贸易官员因替中国从事间谍活动而被判入狱，刑期分别为10年和8年。这是英国根据《国家安全法》首次定罪的案件。

body.en: Peter Wai and Bill Yuen sentenced to 10 and eight years at Old Bailey in first convictions under National Security Act A UK Border Force officer and a Hong Kong trade official based in London have been jailed for spying for China in the first such conviction in British criminal history. Peter Wai, who conducted “shadow policing” operations on Chinese dissidents in the UK, was sentenced to 10 years, while his handler, Bill Yuen, received an eight-year term. Continue reading...
body.zh: Peter Wai和Bill Yuen根据《国家安全法》首次在老贝利被判刑10年和8年。一名英国边防部队官员和一名驻伦敦的香港贸易官员因为中国从事间谍活动而被判入狱，这是英国犯罪史上的首次此类定罪。在英国对中国持不同政见者进行“影子警察”行动的韦彼得被判处10年徒刑，而他的经纪人袁比尔则被判处8年徒刑。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This news highlights the profound breach of trust when public officials betray their duties. Yahweh's word reminds us that faithfulness in small responsibilities reflects our character in larger ones. May we all strive for integrity in every role we are given, understanding that honesty builds trust and strengthens the fabric of society.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了公职人员背叛职责时对信任的严重破坏。雅伟的话语提醒我们，在小事上忠心的人，在大事上也忠心。愿我们都在所担任的每一个角色中追求正直，明白诚实能建立信任并巩固社会结构。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: Inspired by Ukraine, and worried by China: Taiwan teaches its citizens how to fly drones
title.zh: 受乌克兰启发，担忧中国大陆：台湾教导市民如何驾驶无人机

summary.en: Ordinary citizens in Taiwan are enrolling in drone piloting courses, inspired by events in Ukraine and concerned about a potential military threat from China. These courses teach participants, young and old, how to operate drones for various purposes.
summary.zh: 受乌克兰局势的启发并担忧中国大陆的军事威胁，台湾普通民众（包括年轻人和老年人）正在参加无人机驾驶课程。这些课程旨在教授学员如何操作无人机以应对潜在情况。

body.en: Ordinary Taiwanese, young and old, are joining courses to learn how to fly drones amid looming China military threat In a small, crowded room in Taipei, Pan Chien-chin is trying to keep a drone hovering steadily. Imagining himself flying a plane, he gently nudges controller joysticks to guide the insect-like device as it hums through the air. Cheers break out as Pan, who has never flown a drone before, steers it around a rectangular course marked by traffic cones without crashing. Around him are about two dozen fellow trainees, all signed up for the same course: Taiwan’s first civil defence drone training programme. Continue reading...
body.zh: 台湾普通民众，无论老少，都在参加课程，学习如何在迫在眉睫的中国军事威胁下驾驶无人机。在台北一间拥挤的小房间里，潘建钦正努力让无人机保持稳定盘旋。他想象自己驾驶一架飞机，轻轻推动控制器操纵杆，引导昆虫般的设备在空中嗡嗡作响。当潘以前从未驾驶过无人机时，他驾驶无人机绕着一个由交通锥标标记的矩形航线飞行，没有坠毁，引发了欢呼声。他周围大约有两打学员，他们都报名参加同一门课程：台湾首个民防无人机训练计划。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The story highlights a community's proactive response to perceived threats, reflecting a natural human inclination to prepare for potential dangers. Proverbs reminds us of the wisdom in foreseeing trouble and taking steps to protect ourselves and our communities. Such foresight, when coupled with a reliance on Yahweh, can guide us in uncertain times.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻讲述了一个社区如何积极应对潜在威胁，反映了人类为可能出现的危险做准备的自然倾向。箴言提醒我们，预见祸患并采取措施保护自己和社区是智慧之举。这种远见，若能与对雅伟的信靠结合，便能在不确定的时期指引我们。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: Lululemon apologises after Japanese drum row at Great Wall yoga event
title.zh: Lululemon因长城瑜伽活动中的日本太鼓风波致歉

summary.en: The activewear brand Lululemon issued an apology after an online uproar in China. The controversy stemmed from a promotional yoga event held on the Great Wall of China, where a Japanese taiko drum was mistakenly featured instead of a Chinese drum, despite the event being intended to celebrate Chinese culture.
summary.zh: 运动服饰品牌Lululemon因在中国长城举办的瑜伽推广活动中误用日本太鼓而引发网络争议后，发表了道歉声明。尽管该活动旨在庆祝中国文化，但这一失误在中国引发了线上轩然大波。

body.en: Online uproar follows Canadian brand’s use of taiko drum at sponsored festival held to celebrate Chinese culture The activewear brand Lululemon has apologised after a promotional event held on the Great Wall of China appeared to mistakenly feature a Japanese drum, prompting an uproar. The Canadian-headquartered company, known for its upmarket leggings, has been growing rapidly in China and arranged for a yoga festival to take place in late May on a section of the wall near Beijing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 加拿大品牌在为庆祝中国文化而举办的赞助节日上使用太鼓，在中国引起网络轩然大波运动服品牌 Lululemon 在中国长城举行的一次促销活动中错误地使用了日本太鼓，引发轩然大波，该品牌已道歉。这家总部位于加拿大的公司以其高档瑜伽紧身裤而闻名，在中国发展迅速，并于五月底在北京附近的一段长城举办了一场瑜伽节。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This incident reminds us how quickly a seemingly small cultural misstep can ignite widespread public sentiment, especially in the digital age. Just as a tiny spark can set a vast forest ablaze, unintentional actions or symbols can inadvertently cause significant uproar and division. It underscores the need for careful consideration and humility in our...
reflection.zh: 这起事件提醒我们，一个看似微小的文化失误，尤其在数字时代，能多么迅速地引发广泛的公众情绪。正如一点火花能点燃整片森林，无意的行为或象征也可能不经意间造成巨大的争议和分歧。这强调了我们在互动中需要谨慎思考和谦卑，认识到即使是微小的细节也可能产生深远的影响。

verse.textEn: The tongue is a small part of the body, but it makes great boasts. Consider what a great forest is set on fire by a small spark.
verse.textZh: 舌头在百体里也是最小的，却能说大话。看哪，最小的火能点着最大的树林。

title.en: They were forced into marriage and abused. Now women facing exploitation in China have a glimmer of hope
title.zh: 她们被迫结婚并遭受虐待。现在，中国面临剥削的女性有了一线希望

summary.en: Female activists are secretly working to locate and assist vulnerable women in China who have been forced into marriage and subjected to abuse, as they believe authorities are not adequately protecting them.
summary.zh: 在中国，女性活动家们正在秘密寻找并帮助那些被迫结婚并遭受虐待的弱势女性，因为她们担心官方未能提供足够的保护。

body.en: Female activists are working in the shadows to find and support vulnerable women they fear are being failed by authorities Last summer, Xiaocao, a softly spoken woman in her 40s, received a tip-off that in Lüliang, a small city in China’s Shanxi province, vulnerable women were being forced into marriages. Along with another volunteer, she wanted to investigate. After leaving Beijing, the two volunteers travelled south for hours, on trains and in rental cars. A few villages turned out to be dead ends. But on the final day of their trip, the women stopped in a county where they’d heard about a woman with learning disabilities who was “married” to two brothers. Soon, they found her. Continue reading...
body.zh: 女性活动人士正在暗中寻找和支持她们担心当局辜负的弱势女性。去年夏天，40 多岁、说话轻声细语的小曹接到举报，称在中国山西省的一个小城市吕梁，弱势女性正在被迫结婚。她想和另一名志愿者一起进行调查。离开北京后，两名志愿者乘坐火车和租车向南行驶了几个小时。一些村庄变成了死胡同。但在旅行的最后一天，妇女们在一个县停下来，她们听说那里有一名有学习障碍的妇女“嫁给”了两个兄弟。很快，他们就找到了她。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story highlights the courageous work of activists who step in when vulnerable individuals are failed by systems meant to protect them. Their efforts embody the call to speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, advocating for justice and dignity for the exploited.
reflection.zh: 这个故事彰显了活动家们的勇气，当弱势群体未能得到应有的保护时，她们挺身而出。她们的努力体现了为那些无法为自己发声的人说话的呼召，为受剥削者争取正义和尊严。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: The Guardian view on the global baby bust: people are having fewer children – even where they say they want more | Editorial
title.zh: 《卫报》观点：全球生育率暴跌——人们生育的孩子越来越少，即使他们说想要更多 | 社论

summary.en: A new report indicates that global fertility rates are falling faster and spreading further than anticipated, with India's fertility now below the level needed for population stability. This trend means that two-thirds of the world's population now lives in countries with declining birth rates.
summary.zh: 一份新报告指出，全球生育率下降的速度和范围都超出了预期，印度生育率已降至维持人口稳定所需的水平以下。这一趋势意味着全球三分之二的人口生活在生育率下降的国家。

body.en: Indian fertility has fallen below the rate required for population stability, in further evidence of the unexpectedly rapid decline in births internationally The global fall in fertility rates has arrived faster and spread further than anticipated. Two-thirds of people now live in countries that have slipped below the replacement rate – 2.1 births per woman – required for a stable population. Last month, India revealed that its fertility rate had fallen to just 1.9 . The world’s two most populous nations, which pursued cruel and coercive policies to cut births, both face shrinking populations. China’s fertility rate is now around 1, and births last year fell below 8 million – just over half the number projected when the “one child” policy was axed 10 years ago, and comparable to the total in 1738, when its population was 150 million. It’s further proof that what was seen as a phenomenon of rich nations has spread far beyond them. East Asia led the way. But Albania and Chile have far lower rates than the US or England and Wales (themselves experiencing record lows of 1.6 and 1.4). Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
body.zh: 印度的生育率已降至人口稳定所需的水平以下，这进一步证明了国际上出生率出人意料地迅速下降。全球生育率下降的速度和蔓延范围都超出了预期。目前，三分之二的人口生活在人口更替率（每名妇女生育 2.1 胎）以下的国家。上个月，印度透露其生育率已降至仅 1.9。世界上两个人口最多的国家都推行残酷和强制性的政策来减少生育，但都面临着人口萎缩的问题。目前中国的生育率约为1，去年的出生人数跌至800万以下——仅略高于10年前取消“独生子女”政策时预计数字的一半，与1738年的总人口相当，当时的人口为1.5亿。这进一步证明，被视为富裕国家现象的现象已经远远超出了它们的范围。东亚处于领先地位。但阿尔巴尼亚和智利的利率远低于美国或英格兰和威尔士（它们自己也经历过 1.6 和 1.4 的历史低点）。您对本文提出的问题有什么看法吗？如果您想通过电子邮件提交最多 300 字的回复，以便考虑在我们的信件部分发布，请单击此处。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The global decline in birth rates highlights a significant shift in societal patterns regarding family and future generations. Psalm 127:3 reminds us that children are a heritage from Yahweh, a reward and a blessing that enrich life and carry hope for the future. This perspective invites reflection on the profound value of each new life.
reflection.zh: 全球生育率下降的趋势，反映了社会在家庭和未来世代模式上的重大转变。诗篇127:3提醒我们，儿女是雅伟所赐的产业，是祂所给的赏赐，他们丰富生命，承载着未来的希望。这一视角邀请我们反思每个新生命的深远价值。

verse.textEn: Children are a heritage from Yahweh, offspring a reward from him.
verse.textZh: 儿女是雅伟所赐的产业。

title.en: Australia undergoing historic decline in support for multiculturalism amid rising fear and pessimism, poll finds
title.zh: 民意调查发现，随着恐惧和悲观情绪的加剧，澳大利亚对多元文化主义的支持率正在经历历史性下降

summary.en: Share of people who say cultural diversity has been good for the nation plunges from 90% in 2024 to 73% in 2026, Lowy Institute survey finds Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast Australia is undergoing a historic decline in support for multiculturalism,...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Share of people who say cultural diversity has been good for the nation plunges from 90% in 2024 to 73% in 2026, Lowy Institute survey finds Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Australia is undergoing a historic decline in support for multiculturalism, according to the Lowy Institute’s annual poll, amid a groundswell of fear rooted in mounting economic pessimism and an increasingly illiberal and chaotic world order. The Lowy poll is the latest edition of the country’s longest-running survey of Australians’ opinions of the world and their place in it, and revealed a record low 31% of the more than 2,000 people surveyed had faith in the United States to act responsibly on the world stage, and just one in five trust the president, Donald Trump, to do the right thing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 洛伊研究所的调查发现，认为文化多样性对国家有利的人数比例从 2024 年的 90% 下降到 2026 年的 73%。洛伊研究所的年度民意调查显示，由于经济悲观情绪日益高涨以及世界秩序日益不自由和混乱，澳大利亚对多元文化主义的支持率正在经历历史性下降。洛伊民意调查是该国针对澳大利亚人对世界的看法及其在世界中的地位进行的持续时间最长的调查的最新版本，调查显示，在 2,000 多名接受调查的人中，有 31% 的人相信美国在世界舞台上负责任地行事，只有五分之一的人相信唐纳德·特朗普总统会做正确的事，创下历史新低。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to hope, endurance, and faithful rebuilding. Romans 12:12 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with steady hope and perseverance, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到盼望、忍耐与重建。Romans 12:12提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以坚定盼望与忍耐来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: Jonno Duniam calls Pauline Hanson’s push for monoculture ‘bizarre’ – as it happened
title.zh: 澳大利亚政治直播：简·休姆抨击房产税改革的“虚伪”，拍卖清盘率跌破50%

summary.en: Deputy Liberal leader Jane Hume has criticized proposed property tax reforms, accusing Labor politicians of hypocrisy. She claims they are removing opportunities for others to build wealth through negative gearing, a method they themselves utilized.
summary.zh: 自由党副领袖简·休姆批评了拟议的房产税改革，指责工党政客虚伪。她声称，工党政客在自己曾利用负扣税积累财富后，现在却在阻止他人通过同样方式积累财富。

body.en: This blog is now closed Western Australian poultry farms locked down as second wild bird dies from H5N1 bird flu Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Hume has no problem with more debate on NDIS changes, but criticises ‘horse trading’ between Labor and the Greens Jane Hume is speaking to RN Breakfast now, saying the Coalition has no problem with increased scrutiny over changes to the NDIS should the Greens negotiate a longer inquiry into the scheme the week. I suppose one of our concerns is that perhaps the changes don’t go far enough in addressing the rorts and the criminal behaviour that we’ve seen embedded in the NDIS system now. We want to make sure that they are appropriately addressed. And we also want to make sure that Australia’s most vulnerable are well cared for. And there does seem to be some oversights in there. So I have no problems with scrutiny of legislation. It’s no surprise that the Greens have got into horse trading with Labor over this. We know exactly what it is that they do. This is their modus operandi. I think that speaks volumes of this Labor government’s priorities. Continue reading...
body.zh: 自由党副领袖表示，工党政客在利用负扣税创造财富后，把梯子拉到了他们身后。关注今天的新闻直播 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 休姆对关于 NDIS 变更的更多辩论没有问题，但批评工党和绿党之间的“讨价还价” 简·休姆现在在接受 RN Breakfast 采访时表示，如果绿党在本周就该计划进行更长时间的调查，联盟党对加强对 NDIS 变更的审查没有问题。我想我们担心的问题之一是，也许这些变化在解决我们现在看到的 NDIS 系统中嵌入的侵权行为和犯罪行为方面还远远不够。我们希望确保这些问题得到适当解决。我们还希望确保澳大利亚最弱势的群体得到良好的照顾。而且这里面似乎确实存在一些疏忽。所以我对立法审查没有任何问题。绿党因此与工党进行讨价还价也就不足为奇了。我们确切地知道他们在做什么。这就是他们的作案手法。我认为这充分说明了工党政府的优先事项。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This political debate highlights the ongoing tension between individual economic advancement and the pursuit of equitable policies for all. It reminds us of the call to act justly and with integrity, especially when shaping systems that affect people's ability to thrive.
reflection.zh: 这场政治辩论凸显了个人经济发展与为所有人追求公平政策之间持续存在的张力。它提醒我们，尤其是在制定影响人们繁荣发展的制度时，要秉持公义和正直。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

summary.en: Canada will gain access to an Australian over-the-horizon radar system that has been in service for over 40 years.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Australia has struck its largest defence export deal under a $2.5 billion agreement to provide Canada with world-leading radar technology, as US allies look to broaden their security relationships.

The landmark pact was signed in Canberra on Monday by Defence Minister Richard Marles and Canada's secretary of state for defence procurement Stephen Fuhr.

"Today's agreement really is a historic moment for Australia's defence industry, but it is also a historic moment in the bilateral relationship between Australia and Canada," Marles said.

Canada will use Australia's Jindalee Operational Radar Network, known as JORN, to surveil vast swathes of the Arctic.

The over-the-horizon system has been in service for 40 years, with the system able to detect aircraft and ships up to 3,000km from the northern Australian coast.

Fuhr pointed to both nations being Commonwealth countries and Five Eyes partners, an intelligence-sharing arrangement.

"We've stood shoulder to shoulder for generations as the world adjusts to its new strategic and economic realities," he said.

"We'll continue to work with the Americans. That's not going to change, but the relationship is different.

"We have great partners in other places in the world, this being a very good example of it with this radar, and I'm sure there'll be much, much more to do."

Australia and Canada will continue working towards establishing a status of forces agreement, a legal framework which allows militaries to operate in each other's countries.

Marles said the "exquisite" radar technology would only be shared with Australia's most trusted partners.

"That said, under our government, we have looked to be more ambitious in terms of finding opportunities to engage in defence industry exports and this is something that we can do with a close friend," he said.

As Australia and Germany remain locked in talks about the potential export of the nation's Ghost Bat drone, the Canadian secretary confirmed he will also examine the locally designed aircraft.

"Collaborative combat aircraft are a thing, and it seems like Australia has got a bit of a lead there, so I'm curious to see where that's at."

Federal governments have poured more than $2.3 billion into the Ghost Bat's development since 2019, with the "loyal wingman" designed to join fighter jets in battle.

The drone is the first combat aircraft to be designed and made in Australia in 50 years.

Asked how negotiations were progressing with Germany, Defence Industry Minister Pat Conroy said the government was "very confident" in the capability.

body.en:
Australia is on high alert after a second bird tested positive for a deadly strain of avian flu, raising concerns the virus may be spreading in remote locations.

A brown skua and a northern giant petrel had tested positive for the H5N1 strain of the flu after they were found in Western Australia, federal Agriculture Minister Julie Collins confirmed on Monday.

There has been no evidence of mass mortalities among birds, with both animals discovered on a remote beach in Esperance, about 700km southeast of Perth.

"We are working to determine whether or not the H5 bird flu has established in the wildlife or established in Australia, other than these two isolated birds," Ms Collins told reporters.

The poultry and agricultural sectors are free from the flu, with samples of the infected birds to be investigated over the next week.

It was too soon to call whether the confirmed cases would have an impact on egg or chicken prices, Collins said.

"We have done all the preparedness and all the work and we have learnt from (previous) infections and overseas from keeping it out of the agricultural production,'' she said.

"Can we do that forever? We don't know ... we are certainly working very closely with both the chicken meat and the egg poultry system and industries to do everything we can do and improve biosecurity in those systems."

A hotline for members of the public to report their concerns has been established, as more than a dozen cases of sick or dead birds are reported.

Despite there being no detections in commercial poultry, major chicken producer Inghams Group announced it would mitigate against any potential risks across all WA sites.

"This includes the implementation of a complete lockdown, preventing all non-essential access, across all the company's WA farms and processing operations," the company said.

The meat producer is seeking a regional housing order from the state government that would allow free-range poultry to be kept indoors.

Australia had been preparing for the deadly avian flu for years, as the only continent previously unaffected by the strain, chief veterinary officer Beth Cookson said.

"Our actions at the moment are really to understand whether these two single individual birds have been able to spread it into other populations in Australia," Cookson told ABC Radio.

"Our approach is to really learn from the overseas experience and look at the practical actions that can be put in place to mitigate the impacts as far as possible."

Do you dream of suddenly coming into money — winning Lotto, a quiz show, or a prize home? With rising costs of living, it's a popular fantasy; but does it always change our lives for the better? Watch Insight episode Coming Into Money at 8.30PM Tuesday 23 June on SBS or SBS On Demand.

In 2019, Jules was about to be sent on his fourth deployment, this time to Iraq, when he became ill with a rare autoimmune disease.

"I couldn't walk properly. It was like I was drunk", Jules told Insight.

The Army veteran was in hospital for six weeks, where he lost 15kg and had to learn to walk again. 

"And then six weeks after I got out of hospital, I started having seizures, which I'd never had before," Jules said.

His health issues worsened the following year when he lost sight in his right eye after a seizure. 

"Then the doctors finally figured out what was wrong with me, gave me transfusions and the seizures stopped." 

The following week, Jules was in the supermarket with his then girlfriend (now wife) when he bought a Lotto ticket on a whim.

"It was just a sad paradigm insofar as any strange phone calls were not good news — from the preceding couple of years."

He then woke two of his best mates, who also thought at first he was calling with bad news.

"Everyone I told was like, 'Far out, finally some good luck'," he said.

Jules thought about splurging with his winnings — even considering a hair transplant — but decided to be "sensible" and buy a house.

He moved into a new home within 10 days of receiving the Lotto money, which he says was "very grounding".

"There was a lot of uncertainty in my life at the time. I didn't know if I'd ever drive again ...

"The one thing I could say for certain is: 'I've got a house, and I can stay put for however long I want'."

Navigating the journey after a windfall wasn't as smooth for Reggie Sorensen (formerly Reggie Bird).

In 2003, she went from working in a fish and chip shop in Tasmania to becoming a household name after winning $250,000 on the reality show Big Brother. 

She originally went on the show because she wanted a holiday, and winning felt "really bizarre".

body.en:
Australia's Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has warned against a leadership change in the United Kingdom amid reports his British Labour counterpart Keir Starmer could be about to resign.

Britain's Observer newspaper is reporting Starmer is expected to resign on Monday and set out a timetable for his departure.

The Observer report, which did not name its sources, said Starmer had reached the conclusion that his position was no longer tenable after speaking to cabinet ministers, advisers, donors and trade union leaders.

However, a government source said Starmer remained focused on getting on with the job of governing.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Asked about the potential change by Sky News on Sunday morning, Albanese said he will "deal with whoever is elected".

"But I must say that the history of just changing leaders is not a positive one," he said. "I've dealt with already four British prime ministers since I've been elected as prime minister."

Speculation of Starmer's retirement has been building for months and has accelerated since Friday, when his rival Andy Burnham won more than 50 per cent of the vote in the Makerfield byelection, officially allowing him to now launch a formal leadership challenge.

Burnham, the 56-year-old mayor of Greater Manchester, is widely seen as Starmer's most likely successor, whether through a negotiated transfer of power or a formal leadership contest.

He used his victory speech to promise a new path for the United Kingdom, rather than launching an immediate formal challenge.

Starmer said on Friday he would fight any challenge to his leadership and urged Labour not to tear itself apart with infighting.

Starmer led the centre-left Labour party to a landslide election win in 2024, but became deeply unpopular after a series of scandals, policy U-turns and local election defeats.

More than 100 elected lawmakers in Starmer's party - roughly a quarter of all Labour representatives in the House of Commons - have publicly said they want him to quit or set out a timetable for his exit, according to a Reuters tally.

If he were to quit or be ousted, it would be the United Kingdom's seventh prime minister in just over a decade — the highest turnover in nearly two centuries.

Albanese has previously backed Starmer's leadership, in May saying: "He is a friend of mine, and I hope that Keir Starmer continues to serve as prime minister of the United Kingdom", and warning that the, "revolving door of leaders does not lead to stability".

summary.en: The federal government in Australia has initiated a rapid review of an algorithm after concerns were raised by older Australians. This action follows a case where an elderly man was designated a low priority by the system before his death.

body.en:
Lynne Meehan’s 91-year-old dad, John Wilson, was diagnosed with sepsis last September.

That was the start of the family’s frustrating experience with accessing the aged care system.

"I worked in intensive care for 28 years and have never seen anything so complicated or so difficult," Meehan, 57, said.

Last November, the federal government overhauled the way older Australians are assessed for support at home. Called the integrated assessment tool (IAT), it involves an assessor carrying out a lengthy, wide-ranging survey of the person's needs.

They then put their findings into an algorithm, and an outcome is provided automatically, with how much funding support the person gets, and a priority level.
